verification.reviewMethod: Separate full-ring transcriptions by citizen_outer and citizen_inner; root native-image review/reconciliation; citizen_source corroboration and reproducible pixel analysis. Reviews are independent; Canada/Germany appear to share one base photo.

sources.discovery: Observed published 2000w responsive srcset; natural dimensions checked
Official manual; operation only, not exact-model art

calibration.note: Register the photographic hour-rate 60 datum to the top; derive every other angle logarithmically. This is source-registered reconstruction, not guessed clock placement. Preserve relative outer rotation separately.

graduationPlane.method: 1-degree rays; longest >=20px light run in radii440..518; four robust conic fits.

dimensions.note: Case OD is not printable annulus metrology. Do not infer supplier fit or factory print dimensions.

innerUnit10.note: Dark digits on yellow box; dark-ink is a semantic role, not proof of identical physical tick/digit ink.

typography.requiredImplementation: M3A must measure actual substitute glyphs, preserve full numeral-run centre anchors, tangent orientation and all retained labels; verify live and exported gaps against this photograph. No generic collision-driven omission.

samples.method: RGB min>=200 connected components and tick-axis PCA; native source

numeralScheduleEvidence: All printed numerals visually transcribed; outer26/inner25 labels. Underlying 60 remains even when inner60 is not printed.
